ns2:course.label: Advanced Continuum Mechanics
ns2:course.description: Unified treatment of modern continuum mechanics: mathematical preliminaries; review of kinematics and general balance laws; general theory of mechanical constitutive equations, including material constraints and material symmetry. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: TAM 445 OR TAM 551.
